about_the_game:
👻 What Is The Ghost

A dark blend of suspense, strategy, and horror in a 2D top-down style.
You are a new recruit of the mysterious Hunter Corporation, an organization that hunts ghosts by collecting and analyzing cursed artifacts. Each mission takes you into abandoned houses and other eerie places – but only if you combine clues wisely and survive will you uncover the true identity of the ghost.

🕯️ The Hunt Begins

As a rookie hunter, you start out poorly equipped and inexperienced. Yet your missions lead you straight into the heart of darkness: places filled with paranormal anomalies, cursed objects, and deadly spirits.
Your goal: collect enough evidence to determine which ghost is haunting you.
But beware – the longer you stay, the more active and dangerous it becomes.

🎮 Gameplay Features

  • Unpredictable Ghost AI
    Every ghost has unique traits and preferred behaviors. Some launch relentless hunts, others terrify you with jump scares or manipulate their surroundings.
    Most dangerous of all: each ghost has favorite artifacts it loves to curse – a key clue to its identity.

  • Multiple Ways to Identify the Ghost
    To correctly identify the spirit, you must combine several factors:

    • Which artifacts were cursed?

    • How many artifacts are affected?

    • How strong is the curse?

    • What behavior does the ghost display?

  • Risk-Reward System & Difficulty Levels
    Play on Easy, Normal, Hard, or Nightmare.
    The higher the difficulty, the more aggressive the ghost – and the greater the rewards.

  • Artifact & Anomaly System
    Break anomalies open to collect artifacts. Normal (blue) anomalies contain valuable clues – but bloody (red) anomalies are created with the ghost’s old blood. Opening them risks triggering an immediate hunt.

  • Hide and Survive
    If the ghost spots you, the hunt begins. Break line of sight or hide in closets – but beware, it may still check your last known location.

  • Progression & Equipment
    Earn experience, rise through the ranks, and collect money.
    Buy runes and flashlights to increase your survival chances and push deeper into the nightmare.

  • Skilltree (Mastery Hub)

    Earn Void Essence trough ingame actions. Improve your abilities as a ghost hunter. 

  • Ghost Wiki
    All known ghost types are documented. Study their behavior, curse patterns, and unique traits to identify the entity haunting you.

🔮 Upcoming Features (Early Access Roadmap)

  • Multiplayer – investigate with friends in co-op ghost hunts.

  • Hunter Corporation Portal – compete with other hunters: will you become Employee of the Month?

  • More ghost types & artifacts.

  • Inventory system for equipping and actively using items.

  • Optional missions (e.g., take a photo of the ghost).

👉 Add What Is The Ghost to your wishlist now and face the ultimate 2D ghost hunt.
But remember: every mistake could be your last …

Join our community on discord!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i3 (4. Gen) or AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrierte Intel HD Graphics 4000 or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5 (6. Gen) or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

short_description: Uncover the truth behind cursed artifacts and survive the ultimate ghost hunt. Every step you take, the spirit grows stronger - will you escape, or be claimed?
